title: External market opportunity against acquisition activity, by CMA
business_question: Where is the external signal strong, and are we actually present there?
source_models: dbt marts: mart_acquisition_market_focus, mart_acquisition_funnel_monthly, mart_rm_acquisition_performance_monthly, mart_acquisition_action_queue, mart_acquisition_kpi_snapshot
period: synthetic operating year 2025-06-01 to 2026-05-31, reported as at 2026-05-31
statistical_unit: lead, CMA, relationship manager or reporting month, as stated per file
evidence_eligibility: every synthetic lead captured in the declared operating period
limitations: Hypothetical rules for a fictional bank over entirely synthetic CRM data. The market opportunity score is an external public-aggregate signal that excludes bank market share, branch presence, competition, credit risk and acquisition cost. Capacity is a declared model, not a measured workload. Nothing here is evidence of a causal effect on conversion, revenue, profitability or customer experience.
